title: 第一卷 第19章 日久生了情第一卷 第20章 小小花弄影拿捏
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
;;
“主人，是你！！！”
花弄影望见李寒山的刹那，先是一惊，随即是一喜，紧接着又是随即是掩不住的欣喜，可紧跟着心头便如打翻了五味瓶，百般滋味翻涌，复杂难言。
她万万没有想到，李寒山会来救她。
李寒山没有搭话，他踩着飞剑，带着花弄影冲天而起。
“该死！”
吴天雄看到这一幕，心中大怒，他对花弄影垂涎已久，只不过以前大家都差不多，谁也奈何不了谁。
好不容易遇到这等千载难逢得时机，能够把花弄影玩弄一番，再借助她将修为再往上提一提，结果煮熟的鸭子飞了！
“噗！”
吴天雄这一分神，就被黑衣女子抓住机会一波猛攻，又是一口血喷出来。
“先撤！”
吴天雄不敢再缠斗下去，激发一张灵符逼退黑衣女子，随后带着众多合欢宗弟子快速后撤。
“追！”
黑衣女子可不准备放弃，誓要将吴天雄淘汰。
追击的同时，她扫了一眼李寒山离去的方向，神识探出，却只捕捉到一道炼气期的气息。
“炼气期？”
黑衣女子眉头一皱，随即明白过来，她被那个老头骗了。
那家伙根本不是筑基，只是神识强大而已。
“好个狡猾的老东西。”
黑衣女子冷哼一声，却没有管李寒山，而是追着吴天雄而去。

飞剑在密林中穿行，风声呼啸。
花弄影靠在李寒山怀里，脸色苍白如纸。她的身体微微颤抖，体温越来越低，就连睫毛都开始结冰了，体内好似有一块万年寒冰似的。
“主人......”
她抬起头，那双平日里勾魂夺魄的眼眸此刻黯淡无光，声音虚弱得像是从嗓子眼里挤出来的：“你怎么会来救我？”
李寒山淡淡道：“你为什么觉得我是在救你？”
花弄影心一沉。
这话是什么意思？难道他真的是来杀她的？
她没有再问，默默咬着唇，心中却飞速盘算起来。
李寒山同样不再说话，一边催动飞剑，一边将神识探向后方，确认没人追来后，才稍稍松了一口气。
他带着花弄影飞出数十里，在一处隐蔽的山崖前找到了一个山洞。
山洞不大，入口被藤蔓遮挡，若非仔细搜寻，很难发现。
他扶着花弄影走进山洞，将她靠在一块石壁上坐下。
紧接着，他转身去处理洞口。
花弄影看着李寒山的背影，美眸中寒芒闪动，她在犹豫要不要趁机发起偷袭。
“这妖女，这都不动手么？”
李寒山其实是故意自己的后背留给她，想看看花弄影会不会趁机对他出手，这将决定他接下来是温柔的对她，还是粗暴的对她。
不管温柔还是粗暴，这一次，他都必须将这妖女搞定。
身后，花弄影纤指松了开去，她最终没有选择出手。
“噗！”

"Master, it's you!!!"
The moment Hua Nongying saw Li Hanshan, she was first surprised, then happy, then uncontrollably happy, but then her heart felt like a five-flavor bottle had been knocked over, and all kinds of flavors surged through her, complex and unspeakable.
She never expected that Li Hanshan would come to save her.
Li Hanshan didn't say anything. He stepped on the flying sword and took Hua Nongying into the sky.
"Damn it!"
When Wu Tianxiong saw this scene, he was furious. He had coveted Hua Nongying for a long time, but in the past, everyone was similar, and no one could do anything to anyone.
Finally encountered this rare opportunity to play with Hua Nongying, and then use her to improve his cultivation level, but the cooked duck flew away!
"Poof!"
While Wu Tianxiong was distracted, the woman in black seized the opportunity and launched a fierce attack, spurting out another mouthful of blood.
"Retreat first!"
Wu Tianxiong did not dare to continue the fight, and activated a spiritual talisman to force the woman in black to retreat, and then quickly retreated with many Hehuan Sect disciples.
"Chase!"
The woman in black is not ready to give up and vows to eliminate Wu Tianxiong.
While pursuing, she glanced at the direction in which Li Hanshan was leaving, and when she reached out with her spiritual sense, she only caught the aura of the Qi Refining Stage.
"Qi refining period?"
The woman in black frowned, and then realized that she had been deceived by the old man.
That guy wasn't building a foundation at all, he just had a strong spiritual consciousness.
"What a cunning old creature."
The woman in black snorted coldly, but ignored Li Hanshan and chased Wu Tianxiong.
The flying sword traveled through the dense forest, and the wind howled.
Hua Nongying leaned in Li Hanshan's arms, her face as pale as paper. Her body was trembling slightly, her body temperature was getting lower and lower, and even her eyelashes began to freeze, as if there was a thousand-year-old ice inside her body.
"Master..."
She raised her head, her usually captivating eyes were now dim, and her voice was so weak that it seemed as if it was squeezed out of her throat: "Why did you come to save me?"
Li Hanshan said calmly: "Why do you think I am saving you?"
Hua Nongying's heart sank.
What does this mean? Did he really come to kill her?
She didn't ask any more questions, biting her lip silently, but thinking quickly in her mind.
Li Hanshan also stopped talking. While urging the flying sword, he looked back with his consciousness. After confirming that no one was chasing him, he breathed a sigh of relief.
He flew dozens of miles with Hua Nongying and found a cave in front of a hidden cliff.
The cave is not big, and the entrance is blocked by vines. It is difficult to find it without searching carefully.
He helped Hua Nongying into the cave and sat her down against a stone wall.
Then, he turned around to deal with the entrance of the cave.
Hua Nongying looked at Li Hanshan's back, a cold light flashing in her beautiful eyes. She was hesitating whether to take the opportunity to launch a sneak attack.
"This witch, why don't you do this?"
In fact, Li Hanshan deliberately left his back to her, hoping to see if Hua Nongying would take the opportunity to attack him. This would determine whether he would treat her gently or roughly.
Regardless of gentleness or roughness, this time, he must deal with this witch.
Behind her, Hua Nongying relaxed her fingers, and in the end she did not choose to take action.
"puff!"
